dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings with jagged, high-contrast perimeters transition from dark backgrounds to lighter interior centers. The most prominent structures are located on the mid-dorsal region, displaying rough, non-uniform circularity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated primarily along the lower lateral boundary and interspersed between the larger macro-annuli. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as solid points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an elongated, obtuse scalene triangle. A series of smaller blob centroids along the ventral-lateral edge form a roughly linear chain.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense field of fine, high-frequency punctate white markings localized at the extreme posterior transition near the base of the tail area.
